title: Silas and the Thorn
author: Coral Dunmore
blurb: Mirabel Nystrom, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
